turn_on.name: Turn on
turn_on.description: Turn on lights of the selected DayNight Lighting instance(s). Without brightness/color we use our values (day/night); with brightness/color we record them as ours.

turn_off.name: Turn off
turn_off.description: Turn off lights of the selected DayNight Lighting instance(s).

calibrate_lux.name: Calibrate LUX sensor
calibrate_lux.description: Measures the LUX contribution of your lights at 100% brightness to compensate for lamp influence on the sensor. Run this after sunset in a dark room with no external light sources. The calibration will: (1) turn lights to 100% and measure LUX after 30s, (2) turn lights off and measure LUX after 30s, (3) store the difference as calibration data.

start_sleep_mode.name: Start sleep mode
start_sleep_mode.description: Immediately start sleep mode with optional overrides for duration, brightness and color.

start_wakeup_mode.name: Start wake-up mode
start_wakeup_mode.description: Immediately start wake-up mode with optional overrides for duration, brightness and color.

stop_sleep_mode.name: Stop sleep mode
stop_sleep_mode.description: Immediately stop sleep mode and return to normal day/night mode.

stop_wakeup_mode.name: Stop wake-up mode
stop_wakeup_mode.description: Immediately stop wake-up mode and return to normal day/night mode.

release_hold.name: Release hold
release_hold.description: Drop the hold that a turn_on/turn_off placed on the lights and restore the configured state, so the day/night automation takes over again.

hold_all.name: Hold all
hold_all.description: Hold every light of the instance until the phase ends, so the automation stops touching them. The bulk replacement for the Manual control switch.

user.title: Set up DayNight Lighting
user.description: Optionally select a room (area); the instance name is used for entity IDs (e.g. switch.daynight_lighting_bedroom). You can add lights, sensors and options later.

abort.already_configured: An instance with this name already exists.

init.title: DayNight Lighting options
init.description: Configure lights, sensors, and day/night behaviour.

area_discovery.name: Area Discovery
area_discovery.description: Auto-discover lights and sensors based on the configured area.

data.included_lights: Lights to control (leave empty for all area lights)

devices_sensors.name: Manual Devices & Sensors
devices_sensors.description: Additional lights and sensors beyond those discovered from the area. Leave empty to use only auto-discovered entities.

day_mode.name: Day Mode
day_mode.description: LUX-based brightness during the day. Brightness is interpolated between min and max based on sensor readings.

data.lux_on: LUX below this: use max brightness
data.lux_off: LUX above this: use min brightness or off
data.day_min_brightness: Day: minimum brightness % (0 = off when bright)
data.lux_smoothing_samples: LUX smoothing: rolling average samples (1 = off)
data.brightness_change_threshold_pct: Brightness change threshold (%) to prevent micro-adjustments
data.flapping_freeze_min: Flapping freeze duration (minutes) after oscillation detection

night_mode.name: Night Mode
night_mode.description: Motion-based lighting at night. Lights turn on with motion and off after the configured delay.

data.motion_off_delay_min: Night: minutes until lights off after last motion
data.night_brightness: Night: brightness % when motion turns lights on (starting point, the Night brightness dial can override it)

circadian.name: Circadian Colour Temperature
circadian.description: Automatically adjusts colour temperature based on sun elevation.

transitions.name: Smooth Transitions
transitions.description: Native light fading for gradual brightness and colour changes.

sleep_mode.name: Sleep / Wind-down Mode
sleep_mode.description: Gradual dimming and warming before night mode for better sleep preparation.

data.sleep_duration_min: Sleep duration (minutes, leave empty to use night start time)
data.sleep_use_auto_values: Use automatic start values (from day/night mode)

wakeup_mode.name: Wake-up Light
wakeup_mode.description: Gentle brightness ramp in the morning to simulate natural sunrise.

data.wakeup_time: Wake-up completion time (when day mode starts)
data.wakeup_use_auto_values: Use automatic end values (from day/night mode)

weather_brightness.name: Weather-based Brightness
weather_brightness.description: Adjust day mode brightness based on current weather conditions.
